title: An asymmetrically connected hexanuclear DyIII cluster exhibiting slow magnetic relaxation

material_class.structural_family: asymmetric hexanuclear Dy6 core of two vertex-sharing and one edge-sharing Dy3 triangles

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.0456 g) was added to a 1:1 MeOH/EtOAc (5/5 mL) solution of o-phenolsalicylimine (PSI) ligand (0.15 mmol, 0.03195 g), stirred for a minute, then triethylamine (0.3 mmol, 0.042 mL) was added for deprotonation, and the solution was sonicated for ~5 min. After 4 days of slow evaporation, bright red block-shaped crystals of 1 were obtained.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 min; sonicated ~5 min; slow evaporation 4 days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow evaporation for 4 days gave bright red block-shaped crystals

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of polycrystalline 1 gives χMT = 82.39 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature, close to six uncoupled DyIII ions, then decreases on cooling. Magnetization reaches 32.09 μB at 1.9 K and 7 T with non-superimposed M(H) isotherms, indicating anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states. Zero-dc-field AC data (3.0 Oe, 3–1200 Hz) show frequency-dependent χ″ without χ″ peaks, assigned to slow relaxation with fast QTM. Linear ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T fit gives Ueff ≈ 3.0 K and τ0 ≈ 8.3 × 10−6 s.
